description: This file defines barcode classes for USPS-related barcode standards, including FIM and POSTNET, with methods for validation, decomposition, size computation, and drawing.

classes.name: FIM
classes.description: A barcode class for Facing ID Marks (FIM) encoding a single character (A-D) for USPS mail types.

classes.name: POSTNET
classes.description: A barcode class for USPS POSTNET postal codes encoding 5, 9, or 11 digit ZIP codes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the barcode value according to specific rules for FIM or POSTNET.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Converts the encoded value into a pattern string for rendering.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the barcode for rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode using rectangle primitives.
